g.text: INTERPRETER
trained + adult +
briefed + thanked!
PLAIN + SHOW
short + pictures +
demos + teach-back!
CULTURE: ASK
"what matters…?
who decides…?"
LITERACY: UNIVERSAL
pictures for ALL,
shame for none!
MENTAL HEALTH
calm + direct +
suicide asked!
INTERPRETER DRILL: brief BEFORE ("sensitive diagnosis — translate exactly, add nothing")
· speak to PATIENT ("how are YOU?" — eyes on them!) · short chunks · pause for translation ·
debrief AFTER ("anything unclear? how are YOU?"). NEVER children, NEVER cleaners-pressed,
never family for bad news/STI/abuse (bias + trauma!). Document interpreter name.
NO INTERPRETER? Greetings in their tongue + short + mime + pictures + translation apps
(verify back!) + find one ASAP for consent/bad news. Shouting ≠ translating, ever.
CULTURAL HUMILITY: ASK, don't assume — "what matters most in your care…? who decides…?
what should I know about food/prayer/touch/dying…?" Negotiate (NUT myths!): hospital +
tradition TOGETHER where safe; explain kindly where unsafe + offer alternatives.
LITERACY: universal precautions — pictures + demos + teach-back for EVERYONE (professors
nod blankly too!). "Many people find this confusing — let me show…" shames nobody.
MENTAL HEALTH basics: calm voice + direct questions ("are you thinking of harming yourself?"
— asking does NOT plant it!) · listen without judging · safety first · refer promptly ·
follow up personally. Psychosis: short + simple + don't argue delusions ("that sounds
frightening — I'm here to keep you safe").
STIGMA FIGHT: normalise ("many mothers feel this…") + privacy fierce + language kind
("person with schizophrenia", never "schizo"!). Words wound or heal — choose.
MANTRA: "eyes on patient, plain + pictures, ask culture, ask suicide."
